prompt:
Create a rugged fintech calculator page for truck owners and trucking businesses called Truck Repair Recovery Calculator. The tool helps users estimate how many days or weeks it takes to recover the cost of a truck repair based on repair cost, average weekly revenue, downtime, and financing cost.
Visual style: industrial trucking dashboard with black, gray, orange accents, bold number cards, and mobile-first layout.
Strong hook: “Don’t Just Fix the Truck. Know When the Repair Pays You Back.”
Hero message: “Calculate how long it takes to recover a repair expense and compare paying cash versus using financing.”
CTA: “Calculate Recovery Time”
Sections needed:
- Hero section
- Calculator inputs
- Result cards
- Pay cash vs finance comparison
- Downtime cost warning section
- Funding CTA
- Explanation article section
- FAQ
- Final CTA
Generate static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
